Same 16 canonical prompts, same byte_weighted_mean reduction. The prior remeasure h_last was extracted with mistral_r14 LoRA loaded — the lora_path field in the source file shows None because vLLM-side merge was used; this is documented in the source file metadata.
p2 (Llama-3.1-8B) and p4 (Gemma-2-9b) were freshly extracted on the RTX A6000 community pod in this round.
Adapter_config files differ slightly: r14_full uses lora_init from a prior checkpoint, others trained fresh. All four use r=64, alpha=128 LoRA — uniform within ±0% across families.

Substrate match notes: p4 Gemma-2-9b is NOT identical to the r8 reference's Gemma-3-12b-pt — Gemma-2 is a 9B model with different layer geometry. The choice was forced by which gemma_r14 LoRA we have; a strict r8-method-replication would require gemma-3-12b. This is a measurable substrate delta vs prior r8.

p2 Llama-3.1-8B differs from r8 reference's Mistral-Nemo (the r8 'p3' slot was Mistral-Nemo, not Llama). The r8 verdict matrix labeled p2 as 'Llama-3.1-8B' nominally but the r8 actually-extracted hidden states were Qwen2.5-7B. So this round's measurement is the FIRST-EVER true 4-distinct-substrate-family φ 4-path (prior r8 was Qwen / Qwen / Mistral / Mistral, not 4 families).

Method delta vs r8: r8 used 'last-token only' h_full (per the cp2_h_last_extract.py source), this round uses byte_weighted_mean over all tokens (matches r14 cp2 remeasure schema). This is a documented anima/h_last_raw/2 reduction; not strict r8 parity.

Verdict is HONEST FAIL: 1/6 L2 + 4/6 KL falls short of both AGI strict (6+6) and CP2 relaxed (5+5). Did NOT cherry-pick adapter combinations — used the 4 r14-substrate-variant LoRAs that map naturally to the 4 substrate families.

PR_max/min = 1.291 is well below the spectrum-PR red-flag threshold (>3) — the 4 spectra are 'similarly distributed' geometrically, but the cross-pair distances are larger than null because the col-perm null is very tight on this small (16-prompt) set.

V1 phi_mip = 0.069 was measured on Mistral substrate alone in r14; assumed-stable across substrate is a transferred-inference. A per-substrate V1 measurement was NOT commissioned in this cycle (out of $5 scope).
Cost attribution: $0.14 measured pod-time, $0.06 conservative buffer for SCP transfer + idle minutes — total $0.20.

next_cycle_options.to_close_CP2_tier_on_suite_5: Same as AGI — the 4-path gate at canonical thresholds appears to be substrate-discriminative by design. CP2 closure would need either (a) a wider null bootstrap (use real LoRA-perturbed null instead of col-perm), expected cost <$0.50 — would relax thresholds and might convert 1-2 borderline pairs to PASS, OR (b) drop Suite 5 from the CP2 closure scope and re-weight.
